question: Should OpenClaw core accept the read-only Claws feed schema and `openclaw claws feed` CLI surface as the next stack layer after the base manifest PR?
rationale: This introduces a new public schema and CLI surface on top of an unmerged base PR, so maintainers need to confirm the Claws product/API direction separately from the mechanical source-containment fix.

options.title: Pause until base stack lands
options.body: Keep this as a draft stacked PR until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101328 is accepted, then require the boundary fix and real CLI proof before merge.

options.title: Accept the feed surface now
options.body: Maintain the PR as the core read-only feed direction, but do not merge until source containment is canonicalized and proof is visible.

options.title: Move feed discovery out of core
options.body: Ask for the feed discovery/package layer to move to ClawHub or a plugin if maintainers do not want this schema in core.

recommendation.title: Pause until base stack lands
recommendation.body: Keep this as a draft stacked PR until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101328 is accepted, then require the boundary fix and real CLI proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest available history across filesystem boundary hardening and CLI/public-surface review.
